The [[H shares]] (foreigner share in offshore market) of the company were traded in the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]]. It was part of [[BAIC Group]], itself a subsidiary of Beijing Municipal Government. ==History== BAIC Motor was incorporated in 2010 as a sub-holding company of [[BAIC Group]].{{cite news|url=http://english.people.com.cn/90001/90778/90860/7154896.html|title=China establishes new automaker for "Beijing" brand automobiles|date=30 September 2010|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121018173031/http://english.people.com.cn/90001/90778/90860/7154896.html|archivedate=18 October 2012|work=People's Daily}} It became a listed company in December 2014.{{cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-baic-motor-ipo-idUSKBN0JX06H20141219|title=Daimler-backed BAIC Motor opens flat in Hong Kong debut|date=18 December 2014|access-date=19 July 2017|location=Hong Kong|work=Reuters}} The firm announced plans, in March 2015, to extend its partnership with [[Daimler AG]] by taking a 35 percent stake in [[Mercedes-Benz Leasing]], a [[Finance lease|leasing]] company incorporated in China.{{cite news | work=Reuters| date=22 March 2015| title=BAIC Motor to take stake in Daimler China leasing firm | url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-daimler-baic-motor-leasing-idUSKBN0MI0F520150322|location=Berlin}} ==Vehicles== Beijing is BAIC Motor's major brand, revived in 2020 after BAIC Group discontinued its [[Senova]] brand. All the former Senova vehicles were renamed to Beijing brand since then.{{Cite web |title=绅宝品牌将退出市场 启用全新标识_汽车_中国网 |url=http://auto.china.com.cn/view/qcq/20190708/698453.shtml |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=auto.china.com.cn}} The current Beijing models badged in English name "BEIJING". {{See also|Senova}} === Current models === *[[Beijing EU8]] (2026–present), executive sedan *[[Beijing U5|Beijing U5 Plus]] (2014–present), compact sedan *[[Beijing X3]] (2013–present), subcompact SUV *[[Beijing Mofang]] (2022–present), compact SUV *[[Beijing X7]] (2020–present), mid-size SUV File:Beijing_U5_Plus_003.jpg|Beijing U5 Plus File:Beijing X3 IMG003.jpg|Beijing X3 File:2022 Beijing X6 (front).jpg|Beijing Mofang File:Beijing X7 IMG001.jpg|Beijing X7 ===Discontinued models=== *[[Beijing U7]] (2013–2025), mid-size sedan *[[Beijing X5]] (2015–2025), compact SUV File:Senova Zhidao IMG001.jpg|Beijing U7 File:Senova Zhixing 01 China 2019-03-14.jpg|Beijing X5 == Joint ventures == === Current joint ventures === ==== Beijing Hyundai ==== {{main|Beijing Hyundai}} Beijing Hyundai Motor Co., Ltd. is an automobile manufacturing company headquartered in Beijing, China, and is a 50:50 joint-venture between BAIC and Hyundai Motor Company.
